issues.description: The problem statement requires that the subroutine set_pixel must not change any registers except EAX (i.e., all other register contents must be preserved). However the template contains a comment at the position where students should calculate the pixel address that says 'save all registers you modify except eax,ebx and esi', which implies EBX and ESI may be modified without saving. This contradicts the explicit constraint in the problem statement and can confuse students about which registers must be preserved. The solution implementation preserves registers other than EAX (by pushing/popping EBX, ESI, EDX), but the template comment is inconsistent with the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template comments consistent with the problem statement: change the comment at the calculation TODO to clearly state that set_pixel must preserve all registers except EAX (i.e., save and restore any registers you use), or reword the constraint in the problem statement if a different preservation policy is intended. Ensure the template instructions explicitly instruct students to save/restore any registers they modify (except EAX), matching the requirement and the solution's behavior.
